layers.note: Forms dense stands in swamps, wet forest hollows, marshes and on stream and lake margins.

moisture.note: Wet to saturated ground; shallow standing water in winter.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 800 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

shade_tolerance.note: Grows in sun or the part shade of swamp forest.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS).
